HTML_PRINTC_HTML_PRINTLC.arity: one string plus optional integer cellWidth
HTML_PRINTC_HTML_PRINTLC.wrap: wrap before the cell when current pixel x is nonzero and current x + cell width exceeds drawable width
HTML_PRINTC_HTML_PRINTLC.oversize: negative padding is clamped to zero; content is not truncated

extendedHtml.divBackground: bcolor uses one to four color tokens expanded by ParseParam4IntNum; each token is parsed by stringToColorInt32
extendedHtml.lengthUnits: plain numeric values are FontSize/100 units; px values are logical pixels

sprite.eightParameters: source rectangle followed by destination position x/y
sprite.tenParameters: eight-parameter form followed by destination width/height; negative destination sizes become absolute
sprite.negativeSourceExtent: accepted when the source rectangle intersects the canvas and represents a flip in rendering
sprite.fileDefaultBase: ContentDir when isRelative is omitted or zero; process-relative when nonzero in the reference
sprite.rustOwnedSafetyDecision: batch 4.2 will instead use project content root or declaring script directory and reject absolute/traversal/symlink escape

polygon.drawAndFill: return 1 for a created canvas with a nonempty point set; draw closes to the first point and fill closes the path

cbg.coordinates: viewport anchor; x from left and y in the reference bottom-oriented composition transform
cbg.sameDepth: the source uses List.Sort and does not prove stable insertion order; batch 4 must obtain deterministic sequence evidence rather than assume .NET sort stability
cbg.colorMatrix: 25 signed integer elements in 1/256 fixed point; reference converts to a Skia 4x5 matrix at render time

imageLayer.sameDepth: multiple layers are allowed and clear-depth removes all of them
imageLayer.lineAnchor: SETIMAGELAYERL captures the current display-line index in the reference; batch 4.3 will normalize this to stable line_id
imageLayer.getLineY: GetLinePointY(displayIndex) + LineHeight - ClientHeight; negative index is an error
imageLayer.depthZero: accepted by the reference ImageLayer manager; unlike CBG, no zero-depth rejection is present
imageLayer.offscreenDifference: reference pauses SpriteAnime offscreen; batch 4 intentionally preserves logical animation time and only suppresses drawing
imageLayer.headlessReference: the fixed reference CLI reaches EmueraConsole.SetImageLayer for both viewport and line-relative calls but terminates the ERA run with NullReferenceException because its headless console has no native window ScrollBar; successful rendering semantics are therefore source-derived, while that runtime error is frozen by the oracle

ownedSaveV2.authority: RustyEra-owned contract; external snake saves remain out of scope
state: SQL identities sorted with exact 32-byte durable SHA-256 revisions
ownedSaveV2.atomicity: restore into candidate state and commit only after variables, RNG, and every exact SQL revision succeed
ownedSaveV2.preconditions: no pending SQL operation, reader, or transaction
ownedSaveV2.compatibility: bare 1808 remains original-profile output; snake envelope v1 and external snake saves are explicitly rejected

bbas.policy: do not fabricate or modify resources; preserve the reference zero-row result if it remains executable

reusedEvidence.rng: fixture-snake-batch2-policy already freezes the legal 624-word SFMT state plus index, replay sequence, and invalid-index rejection
reusedEvidence.sql: fixture-snake-batch3-sql-oracle already freezes connection, transaction, reader, scalar, parameter, MAP XML, BBAS zero-row, and resource behavior
reusedEvidence.saveV2Boundary: batch 4.0 freezes the Rust-owned state/envelope contract only; no reference capture may be represented as external snake-save compatibility
